_comment_version: Do not change the version number! It is used for automatic config updates.
_comment_INFO_2: CHANCES: The 'chance' field works proportionally. For the best experience,
_comment_INFO_3: make sure the sum of all chances in a single group [ ] equals exactly 100.
_comment_INFO_4: If they don't sum to 100, the mod will still safely calculate the odds,
_comment_INFO_5: but the actual drop percentages will differ from the written values.
_comment_INFO_8: COLORS: You can use standard Minecraft color codes with the '&' symbol.
_comment_xp: Experience points rewarded when fully researching a mob: [Base (Checkmark), Star 1, Star 2, Star 3].
_comment_interval: How often (every X fully researched species) the player receives a milestone reward.
_comment_milestones: Loot pool for milestone rewards. 'chance' determines the probability of dropping.
_comment_categories: Rewards given for completing an entire category. Default fallback for mods is 'modded_generic'.
